_comment: Example manifest. Publish the real one at a stable URL (e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<you>/ughstorage/stable/server/manifest.json) and set UGHSTORAGE_UPDATE_MANIFEST_URL on each Pi. Cut releases with bin/cut-release.py, which fills in the correct `modules` versions from install_*.sh and signs with your Ed25519 private key. Devices verify the signature against the public key baked into update_manager.py (or read from UGHSTORAGE_UPDATE_PUBLIC_KEY).
release_notes: Bumps Navidrome to 0.55.0 and Immich to v1.145.0.
